title: Telling and writing stories
intro: Stories have characters and a place. A beginning introduces the situation, a middle shows what happens, and an ending tells what changes. Plan aloud before writing.
support: کیسه کرکټرونه او ځای لري. پیل، منځ او پای وګورئ. لومړی خپله کیسه ووایئ، بیا یې ولیکئ.
text: Once upon a time, Sami packed a red bag. At the park his apple rolled under a bench. Sami could not reach it. A friend used a stick to roll it back. Sami thanked his friend.
model: First Sami packs. Next the apple rolls away. Last the friend helps. A three-picture retelling can use a short caption per event. A poem can repeat a starter such as “I see”.
activity: Make three boxes for the beginning, the problem and the ending. Add one line under each picture.
adult: Have the learner retell with three objects or drawings. Ask which event caused the problem and which action solved it.
adultPs: له ماشومه وغواړئ چې کیسه په درې انځورونو کې بیا ووایي. ستونزه او حل ترې وپوښتئ.

tasks: Name the main character and draw where the middle happens.
Point to the first, middle and last events. Tell them aloud.
Draw a picture of the apple event and write a caption.
Draw three panels and retell the story using your own captions.
Say a different ending. Write one sentence that could finish the story.
Start an original story with Once upon a time. Plan three events aloud.
Write a two-line poem starting each line with I see. Read it to someone.
Read: Sal packed a bag. A ball fell out. Sal went back for it. Draw three events and add one caption to each.
Write an opening for a story about a child at home. Add a problem and an ending.
Write and read a two-line repeating poem about the park. Explain the pattern you used.
